verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs claim revenue recognition with "automated support for global accounting standards," which bears directly on the story's core. But this is a single thin, generic mention, and it does not name ASC 606 or IFRS 15 or describe any outputs. missing for 10: explicit ASC 606/IFRS 15 compliance documentation, deferred revenue schedules, audit-ready recognition reports, evidence that recognition is generated straight from Billing data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data

citations.quote: Simplify your revenue recognition with automated support for global accounting standards
